Changed private Display is explicitly covered by the approved typed positive control; ordinary prefix-looking Display remains 500/internal.

No changes to actor/target/payload digest, current-authority checks, receipt ownership checks, consumed-approval gate, or append-only governance flow. Prior receipt takes the existing owner replay path and separate idempotent audit repair. Without a receipt, the spent approval can be refused and renewal can change only top-level four_eyes_request_ref while preserving owner business digest. Code does not claim Unknown means rollback.

Consumer-owned PayrollStageError distinguishes Operation(KernelError) and unit CompletionUnknown; narrow From preserves existing wrapper question-mark behavior, Display/source retain ordinary errors. Dedicated future keeps Send/lifetime/object safety; the general PortFuture and other workflow methods are unmodified. Actual owner maps CompletionError directly; actual drainer only queues successful stages for ACK. Unknown emits outcome/event/run/source, Operation retains ordinary error/event/run/source without an outcome field. No error arm edits the event status, attempt count, delivery, or audit; FAILED remains retryable.
